text: (A psalm and a song by the clan of Korah.) Zion was built by the LORD on the holy mountain,
and he loves that city more than any other place in all of Israel.
Zion, you are the city of God, and wonderful things are told about you.
Egypt,[137] Babylonia, Philistia, Phoenicia,[138] and Ethiopia[139] are some of those nations that know you, and their people all say, “I was born in Zion.”
God Most High will strengthen the city of Zion. Then everyone will say, “We were born here too.”
The LORD will make a list of his people, and all who were born here will be included.
All who sing or dance will say, “I too am from Zion.”
